eli (eng-platform): Heads up — noticed console impersonation fallback is routing to project-owner SA in sandbox workspaces. Example: when user has both org and project keys, we pick project SA but metrics show org quota attributed. Is that intended?
joan (infra): Yea saw it. It's because of current affinity heuristics: prefer project-scoped credentials over org-scoped. We added exception for delegated tokens but maybe bug.
priya (product): That UX confuses customers. They expect console's "Use project key" toggle to map to project quota, not to fallback.
sam (devex): Repro steps? :eyes:
eli (eng-platform): Steps: create org SA, create project SA, create sandbox workspace binding. Use console to run test prompt -> response uses project SA but metrics show org quota attributed. Logs:
```
AUTH_TRACE: chosen=project-sa-123, attributed=org-sa-999, route=proxy-v2
```
joan (infra): Hmm log indicates proxy didn't attach origin header to metering call. Likely an edge case in auth-proxy.
infra-bot: deploy-claim-checker v1.4.2 reported 3/3 failed traces for sandbox env at 2025-10-12T09:12Z
priya (product): Can we surface better telemetry in console? Per-route attribution in token-level dashboard would help.
sam (devex): Agree — propose small UX change: when fallback mismatch occurs show inline warning: "usage may be billed to ORG". Also add a telemetry flag for "impersonation-mismatch".
joan (infra): Technical fix: ensure proxy copies both chosen_credential and origin_project headers to metering service. Quick patch suggested, but need rollout plan for Dedicated.
eli (eng-platform): Risk: changing headers might double-count in rare proxies. Suggest canary on staging, then beta on selected orgs.
priya (product): For rollout UX, include opt-in console toggle for "strict attribution" that forces attribution to chosen credential even if metering lacks origin (with clear billing warning).
sam (devex): I'll mock the UI copy. Minimal wording: "Bill usage to chosen credential (may fail to correlate with existing quotas)".
joan (infra): I'll open an infra ticket and paste PR link. Also need to update alerting to catch mismatch spikes.
eli (eng-platform): Thanks — can we track a simple metric: mismatch_rate = mismatches / total_auth_calls. If >0.5% for 1h -> pager?
infra-bot: created issue INFRA-1982 by joan; linked prs: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4512
priya (product): Added to product board. @sam can you add the telemetry flag to rollout checklist?
sam (devex): Yep will add. Thanks :thumbsup:
